name: extract-order
description: Structured extraction: pull order fields out of a confirmation email into strict JSON

messages.content:
Extract the order details from the email below into JSON with exactly these keys: order_id (string), customer_name (string), items (array of {sku, name, quantity, unit_price_usd}), shipping_city (string), total_usd (number), delivery_date (ISO 8601 date string or null).

Rules:
- Reply with ONLY the JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary.
- Use null for missing values. Do not invent data.

Email:

Subject: Your order #KM-88213 is confirmed!

Hi Marta Kowalska,

Thanks for shopping with us. Here is a summary of your order:

1x Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Dripper (SKU: CD-401) — $24.50
2x Paper Filters 100-pack (SKU: PF-102) — $6.25 each
1x Gooseneck Kettle 1L, matte black (SKU: GK-990) — $58.00

Subtotal: $95.00
Shipping to Kraków: $7.90
Total charged: $102.90

Estimated delivery: August 4, 2026.

Best,
The Brewline Team
